{{Top|leg}}
The '''Commerce Concourse''' was located in [[Hreas Port City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lenthalis]]. Several groups of rioters&mdash;including [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gangs, local youths, and criminal gangs&mdash;clashed on the Concourse armed with technology purchased from ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'', which had been banned in the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]] by [[Shinda|its]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] previously. Such weapons were [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] in through the "[[Spirva Run]]."<ref name="Journal">{{JournalCite|14|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
